---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement for cradle.
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
---

<!--
Before filing, please check CONTRIBUTING.md → "What's in scope right now" and "What's out of scope until v0.2+".
External PRs need an associated issue first.
-->

## Problem

What user-facing problem does this solve? Who hits it and when?

## Proposed solution

What you would like cradle to do. Mockups, sketches, or links to similar features in other tools are very welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they're worse.

## Scope check

Which roadmap milestone does this belong to?

- [ ] v0.1 — read-only inspector (bug fixes, perf, a11y, tests, docs)
- [ ] v0.2 — editing
- [ ] v0.3 — live LLM dialogue
- [ ] v0.4+ — simulation adapters
- [ ] Unsure / discuss

## Additional context

Anything else — references, related issues, screenshots of canon output, etc.
